entities.name: World War I
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Global conflict centered in Europe from 1914 to 1918, triggered by the July Crisis following the assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand. The war involved over 30 nations, introduced industrialized warfare, and caused approximately 20 million deaths. It reshaped geopolitics, dissolved empires, and set the stage for World War II.
